strings.迭代越高越准也越慢——大城市数 × 高迭代（如 100 城 × 1000 代）可: More iterations are more accurate but slower — many cities × many iterations (for example 100 cities × 1000 generations) can take tens of seconds and the browser may freeze for a while
strings.算法参数（悬停看说明与定义域）: Algorithm parameters (hover for description and domain)
strings.点「换一批城市」回到随机模式。快捷键：空格=开始/暂停，S=单步。: Press “New cities” to return to random mode. Shortcuts: Space = start/pause, S = step.
strings.「导入数据」支持：坐标——JSON [[x,y],…]，或 CSV/TXT 每行: “Import data” supports: coordinates — JSON [[x,y],…], or CSV/TXT with x,y per line (optionally id,x,y); TSPLIB .tsp files (EUC_2D, CEIL_2D, ATT, GEO, MAN_2D, MAX_2D, and EXPLICIT distance matrices); a symmetric distance matrix n×n (JSON or CSV). 4–500 cities. Files that cannot be understood are rejected with a clear error instead of being misread. Asymmetric distances (ATSP) are not supported yet. Format description
strings.算法在浏览器本地运行，数据不上传: The algorithm runs in your browser; nothing is uploaded
strings.高亮线为当前最优路径。数据仅在你的浏览器本地计算，不上传。: The highlighted line is the current best tour. Data is computed only in your browser and never uploaded.
strings.横轴=代数（采样点按真实代数定位），纵轴=路径长度，越低越好。红线=全局最优，只: x-axis = generation (sample points are placed by true generation), y-axis = tour length, lower is better. Red = global best, never rises (the best-so-far is always kept); grey = current cost — stochastic algorithms explore anew every generation, so it fluctuates and can even rise; that is normal, and as long as the red line does not rise no solution was lost.
strings.每多少代取一个点画收敛曲线: How many generations between points of the convergence curve
strings.把本算法全部参数恢复为默认值: Restore all parameters of this algorithm to their defaults
strings.已生成新的城市分布: A new city layout was generated
strings.尚无迭代数据可导出: No iteration data to export yet
strings.还没有运行结果可导出：先点「开始」跑一次: Nothing to export yet: press “Start” and run once first
strings.结果已导出（swarm-result/v1，可用 python swarm.py: Result exported (swarm-result/v1; reproduce with python swarm.py replay)
strings.实验包已导出（数据 + 算法源码 + 复跑说明）: Experiment bundle exported (data + algorithm source + re-run instructions)
strings.算法源码加载中，请稍候…: Loading the algorithm source, please wait…
strings.算法源码加载失败，仅导出数据部分: Could not load the algorithm source; exporting the data part only
strings.引擎还在加载，请稍候再导入: The engine is still loading; please import again shortly
strings.点「开始」后，收敛曲线会画在这里: After you press “Start”, the convergence curve is drawn here
strings.按当前速度，这次运行约需 {*}。可以随时点「暂停」；想快一点就减少迭代次数或换: At the current speed this run takes about {*}. You can press “Pause” at any time; for a faster run reduce the iterations or choose a faster algorithm.
strings.本站全部算法内核为 Python 3 源码（浏览器内经 Pyodide 运行）；: All algorithm kernels on this site are Python 3 source (run in the browser through Pyodide); an export can be re-run offline without the browser.
strings.全部算法排队跑，请稍候（约 1–3 分钟，取决于城市数与设备性能）…: Running all algorithms in turn, please wait (about 1–3 minutes depending on the number of cities and your device)…
strings.你的浏览器版本太旧，无法运行浏览器内的 Python（Pyodide）。在线演示: Your browser is too old to run Python in the browser (Pyodide). The online demos need Chrome / Edge 111+, Firefox 114+ or Safari 16.4+; update your browser and try again. The encyclopedia and algorithm descriptions are unaffected and can still be read.
